description: Free. Decode any x402 payment request (from a URL, a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or a 402 body) into plain English with warnings, and optionally verify a signed payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT header) the way a facilitator would: recipient, amount, time window, EIP-712 signature against the token's real domain, nonce reuse and balance. Every failed check comes with the fix.

body.description: JSON body for a POST url.

payment.description: Optional signed payment header value to verify.

requirement.description: Instead of url: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value (base64) or the 402 JSON body.

url.description: The paid endpoint URL (https). It is called once, without payment, to read its 402.

name: x402_check

requirement.description: Decoded payment request: options in plain English, warnings

verification.description: If a payment was given: each facilitator check, pass/fail, and the fix

title: x402 debugger
